npc.lotrrevival.friendlyfire.hint: Your blow did nothing: the folk of this faction are your friends. To hit friendly NPCs on purpose, use /lotr npc friendlyfire on. This hint is shown only once.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.farmer_friendly.1: The barley is coming on beautifully this year. A friend like you deserves a bit of luck.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.farmer_friendly.2: Rain on Monday, sun by Wednesday. That is how a good crop likes it.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.farmer_friendly.3: Come and see the pumpkins if you can spare a moment. The biggest are the size of a pony.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.farmer_friendly.4: Hard work and good soil, that is all a farmer needs. And decent company, naturally.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.farmer_friendly.5: Mind the furrows. I spent all morning on those rows.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.flee.4: I am only a hobbit, leave me be!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.flee.5: Out of my way, out of my way!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.friendly.1: Well met! The kettle is always on in this part of the world.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.friendly.2: Good to see a friendly face on the lane. Mind the mud by the mill.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.friendly.3: You have the look of someone who has walked a long way. Rest your feet a while.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.friendly.4: Folk like you are welcome here. Come back at harvest and there will be pie.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.friendly.5: If more travellers were as decent as you, we would never bother with latches.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.hostile.1: Stay back! I know your sort and I want no part of you.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.hostile.2: Be off with you, before I fetch the Bounders!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.hostile.3: I have nothing to say to the likes of you. Go on, away!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.hostile.4: You are not welcome here. Not one bit.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.hostile.5: Do not come a step closer, I am warning you.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.innkeeper_friendl: Welcome, welcome! The ale is fresh and the fire is warm.
A friend of the Shire drinks well in my house. Make yourself comfortable.
Stew on the hob, bread in the oven. You came at exactly the right time.
Sit anywhere you like. The back bench has the best view of the hearth.
Another traveller with good manners! I could get used to this.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.neutral.1: Hm? Oh, good day. I was counting turnips.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.neutral.2: Weather looks fair enough, I suppose.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.neutral.3: I do not think we have met. Mind you do not trample the garden.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.neutral.4: Visitors, visitors. There is always somebody passing through.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.neutral.5: Keep to the path and we shall get along.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.night.1: It is rather late to be wandering about. Bolt your door, that is my advice.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.night.2: Lamps are lit and supper is long cleared. Whatever brings you out so late?
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.night.3: Mind the dark. Strange things move about once the sun is down.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.night.4: I was just heading in. Good night to you, and do not dawdle.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.night.5: Hush, you will wake the whole lane at this hour.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.shirriff_friendly: Keeping the peace is long hours and little thanks, so a kind word means a great deal.
The Bounders are watching the borders day and night. You may rest easy.
Law in the Shire is mostly returning lost sheep. Still, someone has to do it.
You have a good name among us. I shall remember it.
If you ever need honest help, the Shirriff's door is open.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.trader_none.1: The shelves are bare today, I am afraid. Come by another time.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.trader_none.2: I would gladly sell you something, but the cellar is quite empty.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.trader_none.3: Nothing to offer at present. The cart has not come in yet.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.trader_none.4: Sorry, friend. No wares today, only conversation.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.trader_none.5: My stock has not arrived. Try me again soon.
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.witness.1: You murdering wretch! We saw what you did!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.witness.2: That was a neighbour of mine! You shall answer for it!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.witness.3: Shameful! Every one of us saw it!
npc.lotrrevival.hobbit.witness.4: Wicked, wicked deed. You will not leave this place easily.
npc.lotrrevival.man.farmer_friendly.1: Good soil here, if you know how to treat it. Harvest will be fine this year.
npc.lotrrevival.man.farmer_friendly.2: It is a slow business, farming, but an honest one.
npc.lotrrevival.man.farmer_friendly.3: The oxen are stubborn, but I am more stubborn still.
npc.lotrrevival.man.farmer_friendly.4: If the frost holds off, we shall have grain enough for the winter and some to spare.
npc.lotrrevival.man.farmer_friendly.5: Mind the hedge, there are thorns, and my dog is not fond of strangers.
npc.lotrrevival.man.flee.4: Somebody help, I am being attacked!
npc.lotrrevival.man.flee.5: Please, no, I have a family!
npc.lotrrevival.man.friendly.1: Well met, traveller. Bree is glad of honest folk.
npc.lotrrevival.man.friendly.2: Good to see you again. The road has been quiet, thanks be.
npc.lotrrevival.man.friendly.3: There is a seat by the hearth for you any evening you like.
npc.lotrrevival.man.friendly.4: You have done right by this town. It is not forgotten.
npc.lotrrevival.man.friendly.5: Mind how you go, friend. The road out of Bree is longer than it looks.
npc.lotrrevival.man.hostile.2: Your kind is not welcome in Bree. Move along, or the guard shall hear of this.
npc.lotrrevival.man.hostile.3: I have heard the tales about you. Do not think I have forgotten.
npc.lotrrevival.man.hostile.4: One more step and I will shout for the watch.
npc.lotrrevival.man.innkeeper_friendly.1: Welcome in! Dinner is hot and the beds are dry.
npc.lotrrevival.man.innkeeper_friendly.2: You look like someone with a tale or two. Sit down and share one.
npc.lotrrevival.man.innkeeper_friendly.3: A pint for the weary? On the house, this once.
npc.lotrrevival.man.innkeeper_friendly.4: Warm yourself by the fire. You are among friends here.
npc.lotrrevival.man.innkeeper_friendly.5: Half the news of the road passes through this room, you know. Ask away.
npc.lotrrevival.man.neutral.2: Fine day, if it holds. What do you want?
npc.lotrrevival.man.neutral.3: Keep your business honest and we shall have no quarrel.
npc.lotrrevival.man.neutral.4: I do not know you, stranger, but I do not know ill of you either.
npc.lotrrevival.man.neutral.5: Speak plain and be quick. There is work to be done.
npc.lotrrevival.man.night.1: The gates are shut for a reason. What are you doing out so late?
npc.lotrrevival.man.night.2: Dark times, dark roads. Get inside before something finds you.
npc.lotrrevival.man.night.3: Folk who linger after dusk seldom have good reason.
npc.lotrrevival.man.night.4: Lock your door tonight, and do not open it for strangers.
npc.lotrrevival.man.night.5: Late hour for talk, friend. Be on your way.
npc.lotrrevival.man.trader_none.1: I have nothing to sell today, friend. The merchants are late.
npc.lotrrevival.man.trader_none.2: Stock is thin at the moment. Ask again after the next cart.
npc.lotrrevival.man.trader_none.3: Sorry, empty counter. Business is slow when the roads are bad.
npc.lotrrevival.man.trader_none.4: Nothing for sale yet. Come back in a few days.
npc.lotrrevival.man.trader_none.5: I would trade if I could, but I am clean out.
npc.lotrrevival.man.witness.1: Murderer! I saw you do it!
npc.lotrrevival.man.witness.2: That man had done nothing to you! Seize them!
npc.lotrrevival.man.witness.3: You will hang for this, I swear it.
npc.lotrrevival.man.witness.4: By all that is good, the whole street saw that. Do not let them escape!
npc.lotrrevival.man.witness.5: Bloody-handed coward. Bree will not forget this.
